reviews.comment: Do not recommend, hes not good

If I put in more effort, I would've maybe been able to stick it out. However, I didn't know what was going on at all in lectures and was too far gone to start learning the material myself. He's a very nice person; however, he does make quite a bit of corrections as other reviews state. You definitely have to study for your grade. Not a free class

No canvas AT ALL. Everything is emailed to the class with hand written homeworks that are usually full of typos. His lectures are impossible to follow as he makes mistakes and changes whats on the board. He takes off 15/20 points on questions for algebra mistakes and will take off points if you dont write it exactly how he did weeks ago on a board.
Terrorism...

Doesn't use Canvas at all. Constantly makes mistakes in lectures, so he's constantly being corrected. Does not teach the linear algebra curriculum at all and only teaches calc 3. Exam grading is questionable, I got 12.5 points off from a simple algebra mistake. Exams focus on memorization over understanding.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Take any other 311 professor.
would not recommend

95% theory and proofs 5% examples. Messes up a lot since he teaches off top of his head. Textbook NOT accessible. No canvas & grader takes weeks to return HW. HOWEVER, he's very straightforward about what he wants. Exam problems are exactly like HW but with # swapped (what happened to APPLIED mathematics). 2 pages of notes for a verbal 5s explan.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Almost all 311 profs teach linear algebra, except for Dr. Chen who taught advanced multivariable calculus. Topics taught seemed to have little to no connection to each other, which made this class difficult. There was a LOT of memorization required for exams, though he did tell us the topics that would be tested. Very disorganized class.

I missed a minus sign, and got 7 points off of a 25-point question. On another question, got minus 10 because i wrote a little too much. Not even to mention how unbelievably difficult to get anything out of his completely useless lectures. He makes mistakes every single lecture. Absolute worst professor i have ever had. Hot take: PHDs should expire

One of the reviews is older than me. Dr. Chen is completely out of date with how to teach this class, and the content is nothing like that of other 311 professors. He cares about silly things like stapling papers rather than the actual content. The heavy-weighted exams are impossible unless you have a photographic memory. Save yourself the stress

I do not understand the positive reviews, please do not take this professor under any circumstances. His exams are like what he says but it comes to a point where it is just memorization. Even then, if you know your content the test is extremely long and time consuming to where sometimes you can't even finish the test despite knowing the content.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He does not use Canvas and grades extremely harshly. He cares more about correctness than your understanding of the concept he teaches. Furthermore, good luck understanding anything he says in class, he might as well need his own translator. If you have questions, you better go to office hours cause you're lucky to reach him otherwise.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Chen is a nice guy. He's insanely smart. He tells you what problems will be on the test, and if you memorize how to do the steps, you'll know how to do the test. On that note, he does not use canvas. He emails all homeworks to you and you hand in assignments on paper like an old school class. Exams are 80% of your grade. He does not curve.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment:
If you read his reviews, they date back... 20 years ago. He's way out of touch with students and lectures nowadays. I had him for Math 311, Linear Algebra.

No partial credit, no curves, forgetful during lectures, and feigns care towards his students. He will not hesitate to fail half the class on an exam, and when you're confused, it's your fault.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I saw the positive reviews and I honestly just do not get it. His exams are simple compared to the review and that's fine, but he simply cannot teach. If you ask him for help, he'll say something along the lines of “please use the method I taught in class”. He either makes you feel stupid for asking the question or just doesn't answer.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I had him for diffeq. He was very straight forward with what was expected of us and the homework directly reflects the difficulty of the exams. He did not try to trick you with insanely hard problems. I would definitely recommend him!

Dr. Chen is very clear about what he expects of you from day 1. Expect to get the grade that you work for. His exams are directly from the review with numbers switched around, but the problems are hard enough that you still have to know the material. Pay attention in lecture and practice and you'll do well. He also is very willing to help you!

He was very straight forward and was clear about what he wanted since day 1. He is an honest man and I really respect him. I enjoyed his class and would absolutely take another course with him if he ever offeres
An excellent professor. Everybody should take him. Can go to any extent for helping you. He is AWESOME!... Extremely Knowledgable!!!

GREAT  prof. who actually cares about his students and how well they learn.  Isn't out to weed out freshman students with his math class-- he's just out to get his students to learn!  His class requires work, but it's NOT impossible.
